name: trpa-claude-skills
description: A collection of Claude skills used by TRPA staff for planning, data access, dashboard development, and brand-consistent design.

plugins.name: trpa-brand
plugins.description: TRPA agency brand guidelines — TRPA Blue, color palette, typography, logo usage, page layout, writing style, and tone. Use whenever building anything that carries the TRPA identity (trpa.gov, laketahoeinfo.org, internal tools).

plugins.name: trpa-eip-brand
plugins.description: Lake Tahoe EIP (Environmental Improvement Program) brand guidelines. Apply to any UI, dashboard, report, or visual output for EIP or its sub-programs (Forest Health, Aquatic Invasive Species, Stormwater).

plugins.name: tahoe-living-brand
plugins.description: Tahoe Living / Cultivating Community brand guidelines — warm, equity-centered visual identity for TRPA's housing initiative. Distinct from institutional TRPA blue.

plugins.name: trpa-dashboard-stack
plugins.description: TRPA's dashboard and web-app tech stack — Plotly.js, Calcite Design System, ArcGIS Maps SDK, AG Grid. CDN loading, page structure, coding patterns. Pair with a brand skill.

plugins.name: trpa-repo-handoff
plugins.description: How TRPA hands off repo work between staff and their Claude Code instances: a root CLAUDE.md plus docs/CONTEXT.md, HANDOFF.md, and DECISIONS.md so git pull is the handoff. Use at the start of any session in a TRPA repo, when setting up a repo, and when handing off or picking up work.

plugins.name: trpa-dashboard-qa
plugins.description: Pre-deploy QA checklist for TRPA dashboards and web tools: data, brand, stack, accessibility, mobile, and copy checks before a browser tool goes live. Pair with trpa-dashboard-stack and a brand skill.

plugins.name: trpa-data-services
plugins.description: How to access TRPA's spatial and tabular data across five systems: maps.trpa.org ArcGIS Server, services5.arcgis.com AGOL tenant, LTInfo WebServices (tabular), LTInfo Accela API (nightly permit data), and LTInfo GeoServer (WFS/WMS).

plugins.name: trpa-zoning-services
plugins.description: TRPA zoning and permissible-use data services. REST endpoints, field schemas, and join logic for zoning districts, permitted uses, tolerance districts, special designations, and parcel attributes.

plugins.name: ltinfo-platform
plugins.description: Lake Tahoe Info platform reference: the shared shell, design tokens sampled from the live site, embed contract, anonymous API conventions, and stack facts for every laketahoeinfo.org dashboard. Load with any LT Info dashboard skill.

plugins.name: trpa-threshold-dashboard
plugins.description: Threshold Dashboard (thresholds.laketahoeinfo.org): the 10 categories and theme colors, 192 indicators, the 13-section indicator page and its API fields, status and trend vocabulary, and the ThresholdEvaluation GitHub Pages conventions for the charts and maps TRPA embeds.

plugins.name: trpa-monitoring-dashboard
plugins.description: Monitoring Dashboard (monitoring.laketahoeinfo.org): program types and categories, page anatomy, the Dashboard card embed contract, host styling, API routes, the Forest Health reference dashboards, and maps.trpa.org data patterns.

plugins.name: trpa-transportation-tracker
plugins.description: Transportation Tracker (transportation.laketahoeinfo.org): site sections, the six strategies and colors, project stages, API routes and JSON shapes, Data Trend embeds, and the TRPA repos that produce the transportation monitoring data.

plugins.name: trpa-pod
plugins.description: TRPA department pod playbook: forward deployed engineer, implementation and project manager, and QA engineer bring AI tooling to one department at a time. Intake, scoping, the qa/_template scaffold in trpa-agency/tools, the four-week beta, and the graduate-or-archive rule.

plugins.name: trpa-climate-dashboard
plugins.description: Climate Resilience Dashboard for Lake Tahoe (climate.laketahoeinfo.org). 4-goal indicator framework, 33 metrics, data sources, visualization types, and page patterns.
